title: CSCI 610 — Foundations of Computer Graphics
subject: Graphics and Visualization
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core components of the hardware rasterization pipeline and explain their sequential processing of geometric primitives.
Apply coordinate transformations and projection matrices to map 3-D scene geometry into a 2-D image plane for rendering.
Evaluate the role of hardware shaders and rasterization techniques in determining visual correctness and performance in interactive graphics.
